prompt: Decide whether a year is a leap year: divisible by 4, except century years, which must be divisible by 400. Complete the isLeapYear method.
explanation: Checking the most specific rule first makes the logic simple: divisible by 400 is always a leap year, then any other century year is not, and finally the plain divisible-by-4 rule decides the rest. Each early return removes a case so the later checks stay one condition each. The same logic can be written as a single boolean expression: year % 4 == 0 && (year % 100 != 0 || year % 400 == 0).
hints: year % 4 == 0 tests divisibility by 4; the same pattern works for 100 and 400.
Handle the special cases in order: divisible by 400 first, then divisible by 100, then by 4.
Early returns keep it clean -- once you return true for % 400, the % 100 check only sees the remaining years.
